Extremely thankful for the investment @SecMullinDHS is making in our Coast Guard and for giving these brave men and women the recognition they deserve for all they do for our country. 

I’m thrilled Alabama will soon officially be home to the Coast Guard’s Enlisted Training Center of Excellence, officially making Birmingham a Coastie Town! Looking forward to attending the ribbon cutting this Friday.

Video

As a member of the Senate Banking Committee, I’ve enjoyed working with @Pulte in his capacity as Director of Federal Housing. 

I appreciate his willingness to serve and dedication to our country. I wish him success in this critical role for our national security.

Disagreements between Democrats and Republicans aren’t new, but breaking apart appropriations bills over a refusal to fund basic operations of the government is truly uncharted territory.

Since Democrats walked away from the appropriations process, passing funding for ICE and CBP through reconciliation is paramount to keep Americans safe.

Video

What we saw in New Jersey was not a peaceful protest. It was the obstruction of lawful federal operations and assaults on law enforcement officers.

ICE officers face a 1,300% increase in assaults and an 8,000% increase in death threats. We all must condemn this violence and chaos and call out the rhetoric fueling it.

Video

.@SecMullinDHS has been a stabilizing force at a department that has been struck with multiple shutdowns. He has a strong vision for DHS and cares deeply about its mission.

In my capacity as Chair of the Subcommittee on Homeland Security Appropriations, I look forward to working with him to ensure our brave law enforcement agents have the resources they need.

Video

Honored to congratulate Captain Lloyd Belcher on his promotion today. He has been an invaluable member of my DHS Appropriations team over the past two years and will be greatly missed. Thank you, Capt. Belcher, and your entire family for your continued service to our great nation, and good luck in Miami!

Enjoyed spending time with the Alabama Port Authority this morning! The Port of Mobile is the premier deepwater port in the Gulf of America and a major gateway for American commerce. I’m proud to continue championing its future growth alongside state and local partners.

Democratic policies wreak havoc across our nation, and sanctuary city policies are at the top of that list.

Sheridan Gorman should still be with us today, but Democrats continue to put violent illegal aliens ahead of the safety and security of Americans.

Congress must act to end these radical, dangerous policies.


Fox News (@FoxNews)

Exciting news, @SLOTUS’s second summer reading challenge starts today! Alabamians K-8, if you read just 12 books you will receive a prize, be entered into a contest, and help contribute to Alabama’s score on the national leaderboard. Happy reading!


Second Lady Usha Vance (@SLOTUS)

Calling all readers: My Summer Reading Challenge is back! Visit wh.gov/read TODAY to download your reading log and get started. Your next summer adventure is just one page away!

The lawlessness that we saw last week in New Jersey continues to prove that Democrats are more focused on putting illegal aliens ahead of the safety and security of the American people. 

I remain focused on fully funding DHS and giving our ICE officers the resources they need to keep our communities safe.


Homeland Security (@DHSgov)

If you riot, you will be ARRESTED.

Last night, our New Jersey law enforcement partners took action to arrest rioters. 

Lawlessness will NOT be tolerated.

Vide

It was an honor to speak with Alabama Girls State delegates at the 2026 opening ceremony.

This organization means the world to me as a former Enterprise High School delegate and Girls State Governor. It’s why, now five years ago, I announced my Senate campaign at this event. 

I know this week ahead will be as impactful for this group of young women as it was for me, and I can’t wait to see the ways they will lead and serve in the future.

Birmingham-Southern College has shaped leaders for generations, and soon it will help train the men and women of the Coast Guard who serve and protect our nation.

I’m proud to have fought for this opportunity, and I’m even more excited about what it means for Birmingham, the Coast Guard, and our nation’s future. Read more below ⬇️ al.com/news/birmingham/2026/…
